_comment: T-096 (E3-F1-S2): the admin pages measured for the p95 under 1.5 s figure, seeded with 50 interfaces and 200 targets (run-perf-suite.mjs). Paths are relative to the running console's base; hash routes make every screen directly loadable. A page's optional 'wait' selector is awaited INSIDE the timed load, so the figure includes the real data round-trip, not just the shell.
